description: This file defines the InterviewAttachmentsController class, which manages the attachment view for interview records within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It handles pre-render setup by fetching an interview object and configuring a Vue component, and checks user permissions for access.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Recruitment\Controller\InterviewAttachmentsController
classes.description: Controller for handling interview attachment functionalities, including pre-render setup and access control, within the recruitment module.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with interview data and configuration settings for attachment management.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission to access the interview's attachments based on their role and the specific interview entity.
